level_truth: none; oblique and lateral thoracic spines
licence: research use by request; a licence form on the page
how_to_get: The owner fills the licence form on https://bimcv.cipf.es/bimcv-projects/padchest/ and signs what follows.
Fetch by the route BIMCV gives, as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; a licence form on the page (research use, by request); European devices and film-era digitised plates, the richest set of non-standard chest projections

history.note: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; a licence form on the page (research use, by request); European devices and film-era digitised plates, the richest set of non-standard chest projections

owner's sitting prepared: the request is a Google form linked from the PadChest page's full-dataset link (1.02 TB) with four required questions, Email, Name, Affiliation and Objective (Academic Research or Other); the research use agreement on the page forbids sale, redistribution, sharing the link outside the organisation and re-identification, bars derivative works except as its clause 2 allows, asks indemnity, and has no signature block

the owner accepted the PadChest research use agreement and BIMCV sent the B2DROP share of the full set; the share's link is kept in SchwingNet's fetch list alone, since the agreement keeps it inside the organisation
SchwingNet's gate word fetch padchest submitted fetch job 40711923, bank and ingest 40711925 and catalog 40711927 at SchwingNet 25159c0; about 52 hours for 1.02 TB

the fetch job 40711923 ended FAILED after 2 min 26 s (padchest: fetching at 2026-10-22T17:40:20Z, failed at 17:42:39Z); the bank job 40711925 then failed with nothing to bank and the catalog job 40711927 waits on the VinDr-PCXR fetch; the gate's status word withholds the reason, as it withholds every line of a fetch log that is no traceback or status line, so it is read on the grid alone (hpcworker job log --project schwingnet 40711923, or grid/logs/01-fetch-STAGE-REPORT.md in the gate's clone of SchwingNet); not sent again, since a resend is a grid job and waits on the owner's word

obstacles: the fetch job 40711923 failed after about two minutes for a reason the gate's status word withholds; it is read on the grid, and the resend waits on the owner's word
next: the owner, or a session on the grid, reads why job 40711923 failed (hpcworker job log --project schwingnet 40711923, or grid/logs/01-fetch-STAGE-REPORT.md in the gate's clone of SchwingNet) and fixes what it names in SchwingNet; then, on the owner's word, the gate word fetch padchest again; the record turns fetched with its checksums once the bank job has run
